scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.start:e2e:backend: cross-env PORT=5110 DB_NAME=followmee_e2e JWT_SECRET=followmee-e2e-jwt-secret-2026 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5175 FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5175 DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=Backend/.env TS_NODE_PROJECT=Backend/tsconfig.json node -r ./Backend/node_modules/dotenv/config -r ./Backend/node_modules/ts-node/register Backend/src/server.ts
scripts.start:e2e:frontend: cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5110/api VITE_WS_URL=http://localhost:5110 npm --prefix Frontend run dev -- --port 5175 --strictPort
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix Backend run typecheck && npm --prefix Frontend run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e:seeded: npm run e2e:db:reset && cross-env E2E_SEEDED=1 E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5175 playwright test
scripts.test:integration:seeded: npm run e2e:db:reset && cross-env DB_NAME=followmee_e2e npm --prefix Backend run test:integration
scripts.build:check: npm run build && npm run test:bundle
scripts.verify: npm run hygiene:check && npm run docs:check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:bundle
